Vehicle Wrap for Real Estate Agent’s Tesla Model 3

Are you a real estate agent looking to take your marketing game to the next level? You’ve come to the right place.

When it comes to promotion or advertising, it is safe to say that we’ve overwhelmed people by showing them online ads. And in some cases, they can even negatively impact your business because the audience finds the ad in their faces and annoying.

So, what’s the solution here? For certain businesses, it is good to adopt a more subtle and non-aggressive form of advertising. And yes, you guessed right, it’s through a well-designed vinyl wrap for your vehicle.

Which Industries should get a promotional vehicle wrap for their vehicles?

  • Construction and Landscaping Companies
  • Electrical and Lighting Companies
  • Moving Companies
  • Transportation Companies
  • Real Estate
  • Plumbing
  • Security
  • Food Vehicles
  • Car Wash
  • Radio Channels
  • and a lot more.

We recently did a partial vehicle wrap for a local Real Estate agent’s Tesla Model 3.

The Process:

1) Design

The client came in through a friend who had previously gotten a vinyl wrap from us. She spoke to our designers about her requirements and her vision. Colour accuracy was her top priority, and we assured her of a unique and eye-catching design. Our designers have designed vehicle wraps for several real estate agents. Within a day, we presented the client with a design and it was approved by the client in the first go.

2) Print

When the client approved the design, the next step was to print the design. For printing, we use highly sophisticated printers and premium-quality vinyl materials offered by Avery Dennison & 3M. In this case, we used Avery Dennison printable vinyl.

3) Cleaning

In winter, vehicles that are supposed to be wrapped, require special and more careful cleaning. We made sure to clean any dust or salts from the client’s Tesla Model 3 before starting the wrapping process.

4) Installation

This is where the design manifests into reality. Our installers are pros at delivering flawless vehicle wraps due to their experience. Not only do they make sure your wrap looks exactly like it does on the design with insane accuracy but also treat the vehicle as if it is their own. The end goal is to deliver a wrap that checks all the right boxes. This Tesla Model 3 was wrapped and ready to be picked up in 2 days!

Now the question is, are you ready to take your marketing game to the next level? Call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to get a quick estimate or a possible solution to your unique vision.

FAQs

How long did it take to wrap this Tesla Model 3?

It took us 3 days in total to design and wrap the car. However, the process varies depending on the coverage of the wrap, its complexity and the time the client takes to approve the design.

How much did this Tesla wrap cost?

This wrap costs $2400. The pricing varies depending on coverage, material, complexity, etc. Get an estimate for your wrap for free.

What vinyl material did you use for this wrap?

For this particular wrap, we used vinyl from the Avery Dennison collection. We also use vinyl by 3M.
